reason: Marasi carries only gRPC over HTTP/2 as a streamed pair so far, and reads a Connect or gRPC-Web body whole, so a full-duplex bidirectional stream over h2c waits for a request body that never ends; carrying their framings as streamed pairs fixes it (docs/adr/2026-11-20-conformance-testers-for-grpc-and-streams.md)
